definitions.gloss: person sensitive to the heat; someone who feels the heat easily
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who tends to feel hot more than others and is quick to seek cool air or remove layers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暑|あつ}がりだ。
{暑|あつ}がりな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm sensitive to heat, air conditioning is essential in summer.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My heat-sensitive son tries to go out in short sleeves even in the dead of winter.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧ + ⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show signs of) + い → り (nominalization). Describes a person who tends to feel hot more easily than others.

USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a na-adjective:
- {暑|あつ}がりだ: I'm/he's sensitive to heat (noun + copula)
- {暑|あつ}がりな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a heat-sensitive person (na-adjective)
- {暑|あつ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧: my heat-sensitive son (noun + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暑|あつ}がり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汗|あせ}っかき→汗っかき：19267_asekkaki⟧: sensitive to heat and sweats easily
- {暑|あつ}がりな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧: wears light clothing because of heat sensitivity

RELATED 〜がり WORDS:
- {寒|さむ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: person sensitive to cold (opposite)
- {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: scaredy-cat, timid person
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: shy person

The 〜⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ pattern creates nouns/na-adjectives describing personality traits from adjectives: [adjective stem] + ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧.
